description: Gate and trigger processor: edge triggers, a flip-flop, a gate of fixed length and a delayed gate

params.text: Sets the gate length, from 1ms to 10 seconds
Pressing this sends the flip-flop back to FLIP, drops the fixed-length gate at once and empties the delayed gate

inputs.text: Adds to the gate length, each volt doubling it
The gate being processed; it counts as high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A trigger sends the flip-flop back to FLIP, drops the fixed-length gate at once and empties the delayed gate

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse each time the gate input rises
A 1ms pulse each time the gate input falls
Alternates between 10V and 0V on each rise of the gate input, and goes to 10V on a reset
Alternates between 10V and 0V on each rise of the gate input, and goes to 0V on a reset
Rises to 10V when the gate input rises and falls again after the time set by LENGTH, which turns a trigger into a gate of a chosen length
The gate input recorded and played back later, delayed by the time set by LENGTH
